This run walked the repository at scope L for infrastructure declarations. The only IaC family detected is `github-actions` (4 workflow files, per `families`). The Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and Docker inventories all came back empty (`tf-inventory`, `k8s-inventory`, `helm-inventory`, `docker-inventory`), and no GitLab CI configuration was found (`ci-inventory`). At the declaration level, the repository defines no cloud resources, cluster resources, charts or container images; what it defines is CI/CD pipeline configuration.

Build and release, as far as the upstream outputs show, is expressed through four GitHub Actions workflows: `CI` (Node build-and-test), `jetbrains-plugin` (Java/Gradle build), `vscode-plugin` (Node publish job) and `Deploy site to GitHub Pages`. Only the Pages workflow has a `push` trigger; the other three are triggered by `workflow_dispatch` only. The upstream inventory records only job ids, `uses:` actions and triggers, so the actual commands each job runs, and any publish targets, are not available to this report.

Four adherence-report inputs are absent: tasks t12, t13, t14 and t15 each failed with `runtime-threw: infra.adherence.check: no constraints available`. This report therefore contains no adherence assessment.

findings.title: GitHub Actions is the only IaC family present
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts**

- Per `families`, exactly one family was detected: `github-actions`, with `fileCount: 4`.
- The files are `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml` and `.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml`.
- Per `ci-inventory`, `gitlabCi` is empty.

**Implication:** the repository's infrastructure footprint is CI/CD pipeline configuration only.

findings.title: No Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm or Docker declarations
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts**

- `tf-inventory`: `files`, `resources`, `modules`, `providers`, `variables`, `outputs` and `data` are all empty.
- `k8s-inventory`: `files` and `resources` are empty.
- `helm-inventory`: `charts` is empty.
- `docker-inventory`: `dockerfiles` and `composeFiles` are empty.

**Implication:** nothing in the repository declares cloud resources, cluster workloads, charts or container images, so no containerised or cluster-deployed artefact is defined here. This is a statement about declarations found in the walked scope, not about what may exist at runtime or in other repositories.

findings.title: Four workflows, one job each: build, plugin build, plugin publish, site deploy
findings.detail:
Per `ci-inventory`, each workflow declares a single job:

| Workflow | Path | Job id | Actions used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CI` | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | `build-and-test` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4` |
| `jetbrains-plugin` | `.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml` | `build` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-java@v4`, `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4` |
| `vscode-plugin` | `.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml` | `publish` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4` |
| `Deploy site to GitHub Pages` | `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | `deploy` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/configure-pages@v5`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `actions/deploy-pages@v4` |

**Implications**

- Two toolchains are set up in CI: Node (`CI`, `vscode-plugin`) and Java with Gradle (`jetbrains-plugin`).
- The job ids suggest three distinct outputs: a JetBrains plugin build, a VS Code plugin publish, and a static site deployed to GitHub Pages. The `jetbrains-plugin` job is named `build`, not publish, so the inventory shows no publish step for that plugin.

findings.title: Only the Pages deploy runs on push; everything else is manual
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts** (per `ci-inventory`)

- `Deploy site to GitHub Pages` (`.github/workflows/pages.yml`): triggers `push` and `workflow_dispatch`.
- `CI` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): `workflow_dispatch` only.
- `jetbrains-plugin` (`.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml`): `workflow_dispatch` only.
- `vscode-plugin` (`.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml`): `workflow_dispatch` only.

**Implications**

- No workflow lists a `pull_request` trigger, and `CI` has no `push` trigger, so the `build-and-test` job does not run automatically on commits or pull requests; it runs only when someone dispatches it.
- Both plugin workflows are manually initiated, so plugin build and publish are operator-driven releases rather than tag- or merge-driven ones.
- The site is the only artefact with an automated release path.
